First, we calculate $P(A\cup B)$ using the addition law:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B) \\  & =0.55+0.35-0.15 \\  & =0.75\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we construct the corresponding Venn diagram and shade the region ${A}^{′}\cap {B}^{′}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041480/assets/e71239d41a4317c2c7c7015ee2947266075864cec768161fdc4874e8b48f5056.png)

Finally, we have

$$
P({A}^{′}\cap {B}^{′})=0.25.
$$
